dispute.message: We received only 110 units instead of the 120 invoiced on INV-1048. Please issue a credit note for the missing 10 units.

reconciliation.note: Recorded balance calculated before any unapproved credit adjustments

findings.statement: Delivery quantity discrepancy of 10 units between Invoice INV-1048 (120 units) and Delivery Receipt DEL-209 (110 units).
assumptions: Invoice INV-1048 and Proof of Delivery DEL-209 refer to the same consignment line-item ITEM-STEEL-BRG-12.
limitations: Physical condition of goods or cause of difference cannot be established from shipping documentation alone.
findings.next_step: Confirm delivery acceptance record with warehouse operator before approving credit adjustment.

findings.statement: Part payment of ₹30,000 is verified and recorded against Invoice INV-1048.
assumptions: Bank reference UTR-SBIN-88912-AARAV is verified and credited against INV-1048.

findings.statement: No authorised credit note found in supplied records for the requested 10-unit deduction (₹4,000).
assumptions: Credit note search scoped to commercial records provided in active dataset.
limitations: Absence in supplied dataset does not prove a credit note does not exist in an external system or pending approval.
findings.next_step: Check accounts receivable queue to determine if a credit note has been initiated.

findings.statement: Root cause of 10-unit variance (dispatch shortage vs carrier transit loss vs dock rejection) cannot be resolved from supplied records.
assumptions: No transporter carrier damage receipt or bilty shortage endorsement provided.
limitations: Documentation confirms accepted quantity was 110, but provides no transit loss inspection record.
findings.next_step: Request transporter consignment endorsement and dock discrepancy log.
